items.title: VICE ADMIRAL AN PRAMOD, AVSM, YSM, ASSUMES CHARGE AS DEPUTY CHIEF OF NAVAL STAFF
items.snippet: Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau Ministry of Defence VICE ADMIRAL AN PRAMOD, AVSM, YSM, ASSUMES CHARGE AS DEPUTY CHIEF OF NAVAL STAFF प्रविष्टि तिथि: 01 AUG 2026 11:47AM by PIB Delhi Vice Admiral AN Pramod, AVSM, YSM, assumed charge as the Deputy Chief of Naval Staff on 01 Aug 2026 .
